start.text: Welcome, traveler! I forge the finest blades in these parts. Looking to buy, or just passing through?

choices.text: What can you tell me about this place?

shop.text: Here's what I've got. Prices are fair — I promise.

info.text: These dungeons hold old treasures... and old dangers. The deeper you go, the worse it gets. But if you've got the guts, there's gold to be found.

tips.text: Watch your step. The stairs aren't always where you expect them. And conserve your potions — you'll need them.
